title: Theoretical Physics
content: Theoretical physics seeks to formulate mathematical models that abstract and unify the fundamental forces and structures of nature. This roadmap charts the path from variational principles and Lagrangian dynamics to quantum field theories, path integrals, and gauge symmetries, mapping the core analytical techniques that bridge classical mechanics to the quantum frontier.
